title: COMPUTER AIDED DESIGN
description: Introduction to finite element stress analysis for deformable bodies. Computer-aided mechanical engineering design using established software tools and verifications against analytical and finite difference solutions
prerequisites_text: Prerequisites: ( ENME E3105 ) and ( ENME E3113 ) and ( MECE E3408 ) and ( MECE E3311 ) ENME E3105 AND ENME E3113 AND MECE E3311 AND MECE E3408 Introduction to numerical methods and their applications to rigid body mechanics for mechanisms and linkages.
